name: Orbit Tasks
description: Browse the tasks of a self-hosted Orbit instance in Orca's sidebar and start an agent workspace from one.

settings.title: Orbit URL
settings.description: The address of your Orbit instance. The panel's Connect form sets it; the API token is kept in Orca's secret store, not here.

settings.title: Include done tasks
settings.description: Show completed, cancelled and duplicate tasks unless the Status filter says otherwise.

settings.title: Default agent
settings.description: The agent the Start form preselects.

settings.title: Agent prompt
settings.description: The prompt the Start form fills in. {{key}}, {{title}}, {{url}} and {{description}} are replaced with the task's values.
